_comment: Single source of truth for frontend script load order. Paths are relative
to static/. Order matters: the app has no module system — every file shares
one global scope, exactly as sibling <script> tags do. Concatenating them in
this order is semantically identical to loading them separately.
Consumed by scripts/build_frontend.mjs (live app bundle) and
scripts/build_standalone.py (standalone HTML builds). Add a file HERE, once.
.jsx entries are transpiled; .js entries are passed through untouched.
